value_blindness: committed before any stack-identification matrix comparison and before any KLF12 value of any candidate reference was read. No Cell Ranger reference or count output exists: the amendment-14 mkref (9.0.1, started 2026-09-26 00:49) was terminated at 01:09 before completion. The ADOC per-unit KLF12 values committed before Phase 2A keep their not_blind flag, as before
kind_of_change: semantic: the scientific downstream role of the C4/C5 product. No measurement, comparability, derivation, verdict or stopping rule changes
reason: the frozen purpose (preregistration.json 'purpose'; preregistration.md 'What this does and does not do') ties the qualified reference to the Phase-2A assumption-conditioned E_KLF12_HIGH scenario, which Phase 2A maps to a baseline initial_on_probability (docs/phase2a/mapping_specification.json step 3 and uncertainty.shared_baseline = the baseline.cfg istate). The model clock places that istate at t=0, before the simulated E2 priming and hormone treatment (config/protocols.yaml; src/dt_adoc/concordance/simulate.py protocol_lineage). The HT scRNA is an end-of-hormonal-treatment observation (experimental_timeline below). Writing it at t=0 turns a post-treatment observation into a pre-treatment cause of the treatment being simulated, and, because E_KLF12_HIGH has logic = E_KLF12_HIGH, silently asserts that the KLF12 state is unchanged by treatment

experimental_timeline.source: Zaragozano et al. 2026, Sci. Adv. 12, eadz2249, doi:10.1126/sciadv.adz2249; local copy data/sciadv.adz2249.pdf, sha256 51fe0acb3bacab6196290553e35f72103cc7337c4747e0d64b9ad46734a319f1 (config/data_manifest.tsv)
experimental_timeline.authority: the paper governs what was done experimentally; the repository governs model semantics
sequence: 6 days of expansion medium, epithelial and stromal channels
hormonal treatment day 2-6: E2 10 nM + MPA 1 uM + cAMP 250 uM + XAV939 10 uM
scRNA-seq of control and hormone-treated ADOC
quoted: Hormonal stimulation drives transcriptional changes in ADOC
To further underpin the cell complexity of ADOC before and after hormonal treatment, we obtained high-quality transcriptomes from 28,212 individual cells
stromal and epithelial cells from control and hormone-treated ADOC were collected separately
experimental_timeline.ht_scrna: an end-of-hormonal-treatment observation of the HT state. The scRNA experiment contains no embryo; the embryo-adhesion and mifepristone assays are separate, downstream functional assays

cnt.harvest_timing: unresolved: the paper does not state whether CNT chips were harvested at the start of hormonal treatment or time-matched to the HT harvest. It is not treated as resolved, and it is not declared biologically inconsequential
cnt.supersedes: owner_decisions.json D1 'cnt' as to treatment status only. owner_decisions.json itself is not edited
cnt.c4_scope: unchanged: CNT units are outside C4 and are matched to nothing. The T1 reference is hormone-treated, so it does not match an untreated unit

downstream_role.old: external KLF12-high definition -> ADOC fraction high -> baseline initial_on_probability for E_KLF12_HIGH (assumption_conditioned_scenario)
downstream_role.new: external KLF12-high definition -> endpoint HT KLF12 observation and calibration
downstream_role.c4_c5_output: an endpoint KLF12-high measurement definition for hormone-treated epithelium (feature, layer, per-cell quantity, rule, primary threshold and its pre-registered variants), applied to the three HT epithelial units as an end-of-hormonal-treatment observation
downstream_role.baseline_istate: retired as the DEFAULT downstream use. It is not forbidden, but it is no longer the default
downstream_role.persistent_state_condition: any use of the endpoint measurement as a persistent donor state (a baseline or t=0 istate, or any state held across the simulated protocol) must carry an explicit assumption that KLF12 is unchanged under treatment, or cite future independent validation of that invariance
downstream_role.claim_ceiling: unchanged: assumption_conditioned; RR13 stays unmet; no donor-specific model or .cfg is produced
downstream_role.phase2a_artifacts: not edited. docs/phase2a/* and src/dt_adoc/personalization/phase2a_contract.py keep their frozen bytes. Redefining the Phase-2A mapping is a later, separate unit

verdict_interpretation: verdict_rules are carried verbatim and computed exactly as before. Only what QUALIFIED_REFERENCE_FOUND licenses downstream changes: by default, the endpoint measurement definition above. The baseline initial_on_probability scenario is licensed only under persistent_state_condition
unchanged: everything in amendments 01-14: candidate selection (C03, E-MTAB-10283) and fallthrough; the Cell Ranger stack identification (amendments 13 and 14, including the mkref execution parameters and acceptance criterion); donor and population rules; the KLF12 measurement and quantity (count_per_10k primary, count diagnostic); the derivation, S1-S5, null calibration, thresholds, aggregation and variants (all reported, none selected); stopping and verdict rules; the amendment-05 frozen C5 citation; the owner's B1/B2 resolution. No code changes. Amendment 12's pins are carried verbatim
implementation_pin_authority: amendment 12; this amendment carries its pinned_implementation_sha256 verbatim

frozen_threshold_derivation_citation.rule: at C5 the definition file's threshold_derivation is exactly this string, byte for byte; any other value is a deviation. It must pass Phase 2A RR14's repository-citation check (_repository_citation) against the frozen definition pre-registration

candidate_selection.rule: qualification.select(inventory, min_reference_donors=3): metadata-only D1/D2/D5/D8 qualification, then the D7 order
candidate_selection.fallthrough: a VALUE-BLIND failure of the selected candidate (retrieval checksum, pipeline reproduction, reprocessing, donor-label join, fewer than min_reference_donors donors with cells) passes to the next candidate in the frozen order; a VALUE-AWARE failure (derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION) never does, because trying candidates until one separates would select a reference by its KLF12 distribution
candidate_selection.next_candidates: none: C03 is the only metadata-qualified candidate

rr14_citations.evidence_citation: E-MTAB-10283 (the reference dataset the state separation is measured in), evidence_kind reference_state_separation
rr14_citations.comparability_evidence: doi:10.5281/zenodo.17412607 (the ADOC pipeline code and lock file) together with the committed stack-identification result

verdict_rules: NO_SUITABLE_REFERENCE: no candidate qualifies on metadata; or every qualified candidate fails a value-blind check that is not a comparability failure; or derive() returns NO_STABLE_SEPARATION
BLOCKED_COMPARABILITY: no Cell Ranger stack passes the stack-identification test, or the pinned stack cannot process the selected candidate and no later candidate exists
BLOCKED_OWNER_DECISION: derive() qualifies but a requirement needs an owner decision not yet taken (owner acceptance under RR12, or activation of config/personalization.yaml)

QUALIFIED_REFERENCE_FOUND: derive() qualifies and phase2a_contract.evaluate_reference, run on the committed reference files with the manifest named in memory, reports no RR01-RR12 or RR14 failure other than the RR10 activation clause that only the owner's activation commit can satisfy; it enables assumption_conditioned_scenario mapping only, RR13 stays unmet, and no donor-specific model is produced
